text.en: Most recent reviewers describe the team in Horsforth as caring, friendly, and genuinely attentive. One owner switched from another practice and was immediately impressed. Vets are described as thorough without recommending unnecessary extras, and the whole team is noted for showing care and compassion to both pets and their owners.

title.en: Reassuring with nervous and anxious pets

text.en: Several reviewers note that their nervous cats or anxious dogs were handled with particular care and gentleness. Owners who have struggled at other practices report that their pets remained relatively calm during visits here, which they attribute to the team's patient and confident manner.

Owners report that consultations are thorough and that all treatment options are fully explored and explained. One reviewer specifically notes the vet did not push unnecessary add-ons and another mentions leaving feeling reassured and that they were in good hands. Puppy owners describe a particularly positive first experience.

q.en: Do you see cats as well as dogs?

a.en: Yes — recent reviewers mention nervous cats and dogs both receiving care at this location.

q.en: Is the practice easy to book with?

a.en: Reviewers mention appointments being easy to obtain, with one reviewer getting their puppy's vaccinations booked without difficulty.
Hours and booking details are available on the Yorkshire Vets website at ivc.co.uk/find-a-vet/yorkshire-vets-horsforth.
